rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error — the job's monthly column C amounts sum to $1,579.00, and line 33, column C is the total of lines 21 through 32 (i1095a p. 2, "Total the amounts on lines 21 through 32 and enter on line 33"). The model copied the supplied annual total $1,578.00 instead of adding the months, so its value contradicts the source and is not evidence; the expectation is dropped.

Ruling: model error; the reply copies an answer the interview does not ask on this route, and it contradicts the monthly entries. In fixtures/2025/classm.json case classm.f1095a.1, Form 1095-A mkt_b is answered No to the D3 question (f1095a[mkt_b].uniform false). Its twelve column C entries are $203, $253, $329, $132, $211, $315, $76, $243, $145, $102, $11 and $23, which total $2,043.00. The generated record also supplies f1095a[mkt_b].c_total = $2,042.00, which the interview does not ask for a non-uniform form: line 33C reads f1095a.yr_c_monthly when uniform is false, so c_total is never demanded. The prompt listed it as "Line 33, column C", and the reply took it "as given". The source makes line 33 the total of the months: i1095a p. 2, "Total the amounts on lines 21 through 32 and enter on line 33"; f1095a p. 3, "The Marketplace will report the amounts in columns A, B, and C on lines 21–32 for each month and enter the totals on line 33." The project's $2,043.00 is that total. No project defect. Dropped: a value read from an answer the interview cannot produce is not evidence. Suspected tooling defect O2: the class M generator supplies inputs off the asked route, here inconsistent with the asked ones.

Ruling: model error; project retained; model value dropped from the fixture. The case answers that Part III shows the same column A and the same column B in all 12 months (f1095a[form_1].same_months yes), and that with column B corrected the form is not the same every month (b_fixed_same no); the twelve column B entries ($400.00 January to June, $300.00 July to December) are the corrected amounts the input asks for (f1095a.in_b_*: "the amount in column B, or the correct applicable SLCSP premium if column B is blank, wrong ..."). Line 33C is $0.00, so no advance payments were made (no_aptc yes, agreed), and i8962 p. 14, Line 10: "1. No APTC was paid for your coverage. If no APTC was paid ..., the SLCSP premium reported in Part III, lines 21 through 32, column B, of Form 1095-A may be wrong, left blank, or reported as -0-", "you must determine the correct applicable SLCSP premium for every month". f1095a.b_check is any of b_wrong, b_doubt and no_aptc, so it is yes; the model answered no because 'column B here is $400 for Jan-Jun and $300 for Jul-Dec'. The model set the filer's months answer aside, reading the corrected monthly amounts as the printed form. The values that follow agree: uniform no, column B by month and line 33B $4,200.00.

Ruling: model error; the case states that the form as printed is the same every month (yes), that the filer has another reason to believe column B is wrong (yes), and that with column B corrected the form is not the same in all 12 months (no; the corrected column B entries are $400 for January to June and $300 for July to December). f1095a.uniform takes f1095a.b_fixed_same_if_b_wrong when column B needs correcting (b_wrong_asked true), so it is No, as i8962 p. 14, Line 10 requires: "If your correct applicable SLCSP premium is not the same for all 12 months, check 'No'". The model answered the printed form and set the correction aside, as the landing round's rulings on b_check and b_wrong_asked of this case. Not evidence; dropped.
